title: GTA 6 Brought Back 6 Wanted Stars
yt_title: GTA 6's Police Are SMARTER Than You Think 🚨 #shorts
description:
GTA 6 brings back six wanted stars. Police track your clothes, vehicle, weapon, CCTV footage and your partner, and keep watching Hot Areas after you escape.

#GTA6 #GTAVI #GTA6Tips

lines.text: The cops in GTA 6 are a whole different level.
Six wanted stars are back for the first time since GTA 4.
And a crime has to be seen or reported before police even come.
Then they track your clothes, your car, your weapon and CCTV.
Even your partner can give you away.
Escape, and police still watch that area for a while.
Tip, change your outfit and ditch the car.
What's your highest wanted level so far?
